lines.japanese: 「ただいまあ」
lines.english: “I'm back.”

lines.japanese: 「おかえりい」
lines.english: “Welcome back.”

lines.japanese: 針生蔵人が手を開くと、俺の机に石がごろごろと落ちてきた。
lines.english: Kuroudo Hariu opened his hand, and a pile of rocks clattered onto my desk.

lines.japanese: 「なんだこの石」
lines.english: “What are these rocks?”

lines.japanese: 「土産。鍾乳洞いってきた」
lines.english: “Souvenir. Went to a limestone cave.”

lines.japanese: 石を持ってみると、一つでもなかなかの重さだ。ぜんぶ合わせれば、軽く子供一人分くらいはありそうだ。
lines.english: I picked one up. A single rock had some real weight to it. Together, the lot could easily have weighed as much as a small child.

lines.japanese: 「あんたというやつは……！」
「どうして俺を誘ってくれないんだ。旅費さえ出してくれれば付いていったのに。あと、ひとと話すときは目ぇ見ろ」
lines.english: “Why didn't you invite me? I'd have gone if you'd paid my travel expenses. Also, look people in the eye when you talk to them.”

lines.japanese: 「思いついたのが学校行く途中だったんだよ。大体あんた学校好きでしょう。休んでまで行こうと思わなかったんじゃないの」
lines.english: “I got the idea on my way to school. Besides, you love school. You wouldn't have wanted to skip it just to come along.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、確かにその通りだね」
lines.english: “Yes, that's exactly right.”

lines.japanese: 「だから土産まで買ってきて報告してんじゃない、班長」
lines.english: “That’s why I even bought you a souvenir and came to report in, Chief.”

lines.japanese: ふうむ、針生蔵人はなかなかに俺という人間が分かってるじゃないか。なにしろ俺は寂しがり屋の上に構ってチャンだからな。
lines.english: Hmm. Kuroudo Hariu understood me surprisingly well. I was both lonely and desperate for attention, after all.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、ありがとう。お礼に今度、紙パックのジュース買ってあげるよ」
lines.english: “Well, thanks. I’ll buy you a carton of juice sometime to say thank you.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなんいいからさァ、ちょっとおまえの意見聞かせてくれねェかな」
lines.english: “Forget that. I want your opinion on something.”

lines.japanese: 「なに、意見？　俺に聞きたいことがあるって？」
lines.english: “My opinion? You have something you want to ask me?”

lines.japanese: 針生蔵人が？　珍しいな、よほど俺の得意分野に関する事柄だろうか。
lines.english: Kuroudo Hariu wanted my opinion? That was unusual. Was it something I knew a lot about?

lines.japanese: 「おお、そういうのは大歓迎だ！　さあなんでも聞いてくれ。班長として、班員の役に立てるなんてことほど嬉しいものはないぞ」
lines.english: “Oh, questions are always welcome! Ask me anything. Nothing makes me happier than helping one of my group members as their leader.”

lines.japanese: 「俺いま成人向漫画にハマっててなァ」
lines.english: “I'm really into adult manga right now.”

lines.japanese: 途端に気力が失せた。
lines.english: My enthusiasm instantly vanished.

lines.japanese: 「そんでいまハマってンのがァ、このバルザック龍之介の『水上痴漢法』ってやつだ。ちょっと読んでみてくれ、表紙もなかなかロックでしょう」
lines.english: “And what I'm into at the moment is this one by Ryuunosuke Balzac, *The Water Molestation Method*. Give it a read. The cover's pretty rock 'n' roll too.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、その前にこっちも質問いいすか」
lines.english: “Um, before that, may I ask you something?”

lines.japanese: 「あン？　なに」
lines.english: “Hm? What?”

lines.japanese: 「エロ本学校に持ってくるなんて恥ずかしくないですか」
lines.english: “Aren't you embarrassed to bring porn to school?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに。好きなモンを好きだッつってなんか問題あんの」
lines.english: “Not really. What's wrong with saying you like what you like?”

lines.japanese: べつにじゃない。俺が恥ずかしいと言ってるんだ。
lines.english: It wasn't “not really.” I was telling him that *I* was embarrassed.

lines.japanese: 「なんだァ？　おまえこんなもんが恥ずかしいとか思ってんの。これだからロリコンは使えねえなァ」
lines.english: “What? Stuff like this embarrasses you? This is why lolicons are useless.”

lines.japanese: 「だっ、黙れ！　ななな何故あんたが知っている！」
lines.english: “Sh-shut up! H-how do you know?!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、俺、シスコンでもロリコンでもなんでもないけどね」
lines.english: “Oh, and I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえさんが年下のオンナ連れて楽しそうに登校してるトコ何度か見かけてンだよ。アレなんだ？　付きあってンのか？」
lines.english: “I've seen you happily walking to school with a younger girl a few times. What's the deal? You dating her?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうか。だったら妹萌えとか好きでしょう」
lines.english: “Oh, I see. Then you must be into little-sister stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「シシッ、シスコンとかロリコンじゃないって言ってるでしょう！」
lines.english: “I-I-I told you, I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex!”

lines.japanese: 「だったらエロ本くらいどってことないだろォ。いまのお勧めがこの『水上痴漢法』と『ハイスクールロック「校内精巣編」』と『援交娘緊縛遊戯編～火遊びの代償は未熟なカラダ～』なんだが、おまえはどう思う」
lines.english: “Then a little porn's no big deal. My current recommendations are *The Water Molestation Method*, *High School Rock: Testes on Campus*, and *Teen Sugar Baby Bondage—An Immature Body Pays the Price for Playing with Fire*. What do you think?”

lines.japanese: え、ええ～っ。はっきり言ってどれでもいいんだけど、選ばないとシスコンとかロリコン扱いされそうだしなあ……。
lines.english: Wh-what? Honestly, I couldn't care less which one, but if I refused to choose, he would probably decide I had a sister complex or a Lolita complex...
